step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number assigned for the training issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) to inform IPOC of the decision as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Training ID 90. Start date [XXXX]. End date [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “The client is entitled to collect benefits while attending a non-referred training course.”
Remarks line 3: Type your name and phone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ADJ WI, complete the Level 1 Training screen as follows:

ul.li: Select Based on the information on file, the criteria to allow the decision to be made at Level 1 have been met (National Policy on Levels of Decision) .

step.cmd: Complete the Training Dates screen as follows:

ul.li:
Training start: Select appropriate option:
If the training starts at or before the BPC, select BPC .
If the training starts after the BPC, select Specific date and enter the start date.
Training end date (DD/MM/YYYY): Enter the end date.

step.cmd: Verify the information on the Record of Decision screen presented:
In NWS, complete the WI for the training issue.
